firm_data.firm_description: Florentino & Grimshaw LLC is a boutique, management-side labor and employment law firm focused on collaborating with employers to navigate all aspects of the employment lifecycle. Our women-owned firm works with employers of all sizes, both for-profit and not-for-profit, in a variety of industries.

email.subject: AI for Florentino & Grimshaw, built for management-side employment counsel
email.body:
Hi Tonianne,

Your boutique approach to management-side labor and employment law, working across employers of all sizes, puts you in a unique position. You're solving complex employment lifecycle issues without the overhead of BigLaw.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Rye Brook area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on employment matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
